cases.explain: The verb хвалить (praise) is transitive and takes the accusative case for the animate noun.
The preposition на (on) with location takes the prepositional case.
The genitive case shows possession: courts of the house.

cases.sentence: Он послал знамения и ___ среди тебя, Египет.
cases.explain: The verb послал (sent) takes the accusative case for its direct object.
The verb избрал (chose) takes the accusative case for its object.
Господь is the subject of велик (is great), so it stands in the nominative.
The preposition с (from) takes the genitive case.
The preposition в (in) with location takes the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Хвалите имя Господа, хвалите слуги Господа, стоящие в доме Господнем, во дворах дома нашего Бога.
reading.question: Who should praise the Lord's name according to this verse?
options: The servants of the Lord standing in His house
All the kings of the earth
reading.correct: The servants of the Lord standing in His house
reading.explain: The text says слуги Господа (servants of the Lord) стоящие в доме Господнем (standing in the Lord's house).

reading.ru: Хвалите Господа, потому что Он благ, пойте хвалу Его имени, потому что это приятно.
reading.question: Why should we praise the Lord?
options: Because He is good and it is pleasant
reading.correct: Because He is good and it is pleasant
reading.explain: The verse states: потому что Он благ (because He is good) and потому что это приятно (because it is pleasant).

reading.ru: Я знаю, что велик Господь, и наш Владыка выше всех богов.
reading.question: What does the psalmist know about the Lord?
options: That the Lord is great and higher than all gods
That the Lord is merciful and kind
That the Lord lives in Jerusalem
That the Lord created the sea
reading.correct: That the Lord is great and higher than all gods
reading.explain: The verse directly states велик Господь и наш Владыка выше всех богов (the Lord is great and our Lord is above all gods).

reading.ru: Наш Бог делает все, что угодно Ему, на небесах и на земле, в морях и во всех безднах.
reading.question: In how many places does God do what pleases Him?
options: In heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in all the deep places
reading.correct: In heaven, on earth, in the seas, and in all the deep places
reading.explain: The text enumerates: на небесах и на земле, в морях и во всех безднах (in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the deeps).

reading.ru: Поднимает облака с концов земли, создает молнии при дожде, выпускает ветер из своих хранилищ.
reading.question: What are three things God does with nature?
options: He lifts clouds, creates lightning, and releases wind
He destroys mountains, stops the rain, and calms the sea
He freezes water, breaks clouds, and hides the wind
He strengthens the earth, dims the stars, and stops the storms
reading.correct: He lifts clouds, creates lightning, and releases wind
reading.explain: The verse lists: поднимает облака (lifts clouds), создает молнии (creates lightning), выпускает ветер (releases wind).

reading.ru: Благослови Господа дом Израиля, благослови Господа дом Аарона, благослови Господа дом Левиен, боящиеся Господа, благословите его.
reading.question: Which groups are called to bless the Lord?
options: The house of Israel, the house of Aaron, the house of Levi, and those who fear the Lord
All the nations of the earth
reading.correct: The house of Israel, the house of Aaron, the house of Levi, and those who fear the Lord
reading.explain: The text lists: дом Израиля, дом Аарона, дом Левиен, боящиеся Господа (house of Israel, Aaron, Levi, and those who fear the Lord).
